new_claims.statement: For arbitrary probability weights w on nonzero physical 3x3 cross minors, G(w)=exp(E_w log det^2+H(w)), 1<=q<3/2 and max row marginal<=q/2 imply ||p_Q||inf <= [3e/((3-2q)sqrt(q))] G(w)^(-1/6), with arbitrary self blocks, outside couplings and affine terms retained.

For rho=e3(lambda)/e2(lambda), gamma_a^2=a rho, third-volume marginal matrix W and ridge K_a=C(C+gamma_a^2 I)^(-1), one has W<=(1+a)K_a. Thus for 0<a<1/2 a ridge leverage cap 1/2 forces both ridge q=1 effective dimension >2 and fractional-volume q=1+a admissibility.

On the rotated H8 two-level cross block in the report, raw volume sampling has alpha_max=0.5311251373>1/2, but the globally optimal q=1 admissible weight is the exponential tilt of the unique heavy-row inclusion event. Its KL cost is 0.00194131217 and its effective volume gives density <=4.0777232167.
